n.no: User-facing caller for unique id generator.
Distribute incoming connections across healthy instances for unique id generator.

Each node generates a 128-bit UUIDv7 with a millisecond timestamp and cryptographic randomness. Optional monotonic sequence handles same-ms bursts and clock regressions locally. No worker ID assignment: uniqueness is probabilistic, not guaranteed. This alternative violates the strict 64-bit requirement.

apis.note: Serialize 64-bit integers as strings in JSON. Library mode calls this locally; UUIDv7 returns 128-bit values and requires a relaxed ID-width requirement.
